newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: CRICKET-AMBROSE AND ROSE PUT INDIA ON THE RACK.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AMBROSE AND ROSE PUT INDIA ON THE RACK.

text.p: Curtly Ambrose and Franklyn Rose took seven wickets between them as India were bowled out for a modest 179 by West Indies in the rain-hit first limited overs match on Saturday.

Ambrose captured four for 36 off 9.3 overs and Rose, playing his first one-day international, bagged three for 25 off 10 overs as India were dismissed in 48.3 overs after their innings had been interrupted three times by rain.
Indian captain Sachin Tendulkar was the only batsman to master the bowlers. He struck nine fours -- four of them in the fourth over of the innings bowled by Ian Bishop -- in a cameo knock of 44.
His dismissal by Ambrose in the 13th over was controversial, Courtney Browne claiming a catch. Television replays appeared to show that the ball deflected off Tendulkar's right bicep.
Rain during the break between innings prevented West Indies from making a prompt start to their reply.
